{{Quote|He ''[Praji]'' was an old-fashioned military man and while he viewed the AT walkers as graceless brutes he had to admit they were effective, particularly in subduing the unruly Leffingites in the Battle of Almak.|Dr. Gabrel Treon in ''Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes|<ref name="tinker" />}}
The '''Battle of Almak''' was fought on the<ref name="tinker" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="atlas-oc">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Almak system/Legends|Almak system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almak/Legends|Almak]] sometime between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. An Imperial [[unit]] under the command of [[Nahdonnis Praji]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the Empire, participated in the subjugation of Almak's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Leffingite/Legends|Leffingites]]. The Imperials used [[AT-series/Legends|All Terrain]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] to great effect during the battle and were able to defeat the Leffingite resistance. Praji viewed the walkers as brutish and without grace but nonetheless found them effective in the battle.<ref name="tinker" /> In [[104 ABY]],<ref name="blog">The last section of ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'' is titled "''Inheritance (10&ndash;104 ABY)''". {{Blog|valinkenobi|14/comments|TTSP Endnotes: Volume 1}} states that the [[in-universe]] article was published in 104 ABY.</ref> the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Academician|Dr.]] [[Gabrel Treon]] mentioned the battle in "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," an article he wrote about the [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] family, which he published in the ''[[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]]''.<ref name="tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
The first and only mention of the Battle of Almak was in [[Nathan O'Keefe]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace-exclusive]] [[in-universe]] history article titled ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', which was published on [[February 5]], [[2009]].<ref name="tinker" />
